checks.name: Reachability is plausible within approved constraints
evidence: Player starts at Vector2(72, 320) and GoalCollision is centered at Vector2(604, 288)

checks.notes: QA did not perform a human manual play session, but static geometry and controller values support reachability for the first greybox review.
